policy.zh: 基于公开日历的候选活动索引，并非全县所有活动。详情逐组核实，逐场保留各自日历链接；未检查的余位不推断为可报名。全天、取材料、成人／志愿服务、取消及地点未核实项目不导入。
policy.en: Candidate index from public calendars, not all county events. Detail pages checked; every occurrence retains its calendar URL. Unchecked availability is not assumed open. All-day/pickup, adult/volunteer, canceled and unresolved-location entries are excluded.
